title: A field of orthogonal projections is a.e.-measurable when its quadratic forms are
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P and let K be a map from ℝ^P to linear subspaces of ℝ^P. Let p_x ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) be the orthogonal projection onto K(x), i.e. (K x).starProjection. Suppose that for every u ∈ ℝ^P the real function x ↦ |p_x u|² is μ-a.e. measurable. Then x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. measurable for the Borel σ-algebra of L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) with the operator-norm topology.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (K : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ u : Euclid P, AEMeasurable (fun x => ‖(K x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2) μ) → AEMeasurable (fun x => (K x).starProjection) μ
